mechanisms.explanation: 93 of 400 development hearts have no fit (size key 'none') due to the 'annulus-coverage' rule. The starting valve design only covers annulus diameters from 21 mm to 27 mm across sizes 23 (21 to 23 mm), 25 (23 to 25 mm), and 27 (25 to 27 mm). Grouping failures by annulusMm band shows that the 93 no-fit hearts fall outside the 21 to 27 mm range: 6 no-fit hearts in the 18-20 mm band, 20 no-fit hearts in the 20-22 mm band (below 21 mm), 30 no-fit hearts in the 26-28 mm band (above 27 mm), 31 no-fit hearts in the 28-30 mm band, and 6 no-fit hearts in the 30-32 mm band. Profiling this 93-heart group against the remaining 307 hearts shows larger overall root dimensions, driven by the larger subset of oversized annuli: groupMean lvotMm is 26.2397743438473 vs restMean 23.5893006765396 (effectSize 0.78842208254492), groupMean annulusMm is 26.1196504829399 vs restMean 24.1814269470922 (effectSize 0.783682598813269), groupMean sinusMm is 34.5185607337525 vs restMean 32.3156775956045 (effectSize 0.661545609781026), and groupMean sinotubularJunctionMm is 30.9120404307311 vs restMean 29.1595747136156 (effectSize 0.605181434509487).
mechanisms.title: Annulus Coverage Gap (Annulus Outside 21-27 mm Range)
Sinotubular Junction (STJ) Excess Risk from Narrow STJ Relative to Assigned Valve Size
mechanisms.explanation: 52 development hearts are placed at risk by the 'stj-excess' rule because their sinotubularJunctionMm (STJ) is below the required minimum limit for their assigned nominal valve size. Individual heart inspections show the STJ limit scales with assigned nominal valve size: limit is 25 mm for size 23 (e.g., heart-018 has annulusMm 21.3162948513543, assigned sizeMm 23, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 23.9075688982299 vs limit 25, margin -1.09243110177013), limit is 27 mm for size 25 (e.g., heart-025 has annulusMm 23.019822575694, assigned sizeMm 25, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 26.1350493604731 vs limit 27, margin -0.864950639526878; heart-086 has measured sinotubularJunctionMm 26.48261056391 vs limit 27, margin -0.517389436090028), and limit is 29 mm for size 27 (e.g., heart-001 has annulusMm 25.5522142514524, assigned sizeMm 27, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 28.5705544474013 vs limit 29, margin -0.42944555259869; heart-014 has measured sinotubularJunctionMm 26.8311463740637 vs limit 29, margin -2.16885362593629). Profiling this 52-heart group against the remaining 348 hearts confirms a markedly narrow STJ and sinus relative to their annulus/LVOT: sinotubularJunctionMm groupMean is 26.5045097370466 vs restMean 30.0246399161251 (difference -3.52013017907853, effectSize -1.2156114728117), sinusMm groupMean is 30.5892482692222 vs restMean 33.1623513220977 (difference -2.57310305287558, effectSize -0.772725978362664), and lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio groupMean is 1.02645440665182 vs restMean 0.953344983673109 (effectSize 0.682085964814614).

mechanisms.title: Insufficient Sinus Clearance from Small Sinus Diameter and Compact Aortic Root Relative to Assigned Valve Size
mechanisms.explanation: 38 development hearts are placed at risk by the 'sinus-clearance' rule because their sinusMm diameter is below the required clearance limit for their assigned nominal valve size. Individual heart inspections show the sinusMm limit scales with the assigned nominal valve size: limit is 28 mm for size 23 (e.g., heart-032 has annulusMm 21.9008548446049, assigned sizeMm 23, measured sinusMm 27.1853980884363 vs limit 28, margin -0.814601911563713; heart-018 has measured sinusMm 26.3006749541182 vs limit 28, margin -1.69932504588178), limit is 30 mm for size 25 (e.g., heart-086 has annulusMm 23.5075668607675, assigned sizeMm 25, measured sinusMm 28.6100927234801 vs limit 30, margin -1.38990727651987), and limit is 32 mm for size 27 (e.g., heart-014 has annulusMm 25.8633543516862, assigned sizeMm 27, measured sinusMm 30.7778575461286 vs limit 32, margin -1.22214245387135). Profiling this 38-heart group against the remaining 362 hearts shows they have smaller sinuses, narrower STJs, and shorter sinus heights alongside higher LVOT-to-annulus area ratios: sinusMm groupMean is 29.0481355368023 vs restMean 33.2246133140638 (difference -4.17647777726146, effectSize -1.25423382205296), sinotubularJunctionMm groupMean is 26.7830986506325 vs restMean 29.8592581447899 (difference -3.07615949415738, effectSize -1.06229445590425), sinusHeightMm groupMean is 22.0921052631579 vs restMean 25.4958563535912 (difference -3.40375109043327, effectSize -1.02110774508236), and lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio groupMean is 1.02620177062988 vs restMean 0.956198939724312 (effectSize 0.653102521023595). Many of these hearts overlap with the stj-excess group, accounting for the 68 total at-risk hearts across sizes 23 (18 risk), 25 (24 risk), and 27 (26 risk).
